whenToUse: People book a period, such as a stay or a rental car.
The length of the period (how many nights) matters.
Unavailable days need to show as well.
whenNotToUse: Only one day is chosen (use a date picker).
Fixed periods such as this month or the last 7 days (use chips or a select).
Long periods spanning years (use two date inputs).
accessibility: Add roles such as "check-in", "check-out", and "night" to date button names so the period is stated in words.
The start and end dates announce their selection with aria-pressed.
A summary below announces, with aria-live, the next date to choose and the result.
